product_metadata.title: Evelots 4 Pack Dresser Drawer Organizer-Divider-Sock-Belt-Scarf-Underwear-112 Slots Total
features: Organize Your Drawers: Evelots set of 4 honeycomb design drawer organizers are excellent for keeping all of your drawers neat and organized. Perfect for separating undergarments, pairs of socks, belts, tights, stockings, ties, scarves, baby clothes, etc.

Multiple Uses: Holds clothes, office accessories, arts and crafts, makeup, jewelry, and other small objects. Made of flexible, light weight, and durable plastic, each honeycomb has 18 SLOTS PLUS 10 SLOTS AROUND FOR A TOTAL OF 112 SLOTS.
Easy to Assemble: Start organizing in seconds. Honeycomb dividers easily snap together. The size can be cut for a customized fit.
Measures approximately 14 Inches Long x 13.5 Inches Wide x 2.5 Inches Height assembled. Each individual slot is about 3.5 Inches Long x 3 Inches wide.
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.

details.Specific Uses For Product: Tie & Belt Storage, Undergarment Storage, Bedroom Organizer, Drawer Organization, Sock Storage
